description:
Single source of truth for the pgp-keys-map.list consumed by
        pgpverify-maven-plugin across Security4Media's Maven repositories.
        Packaged as a jar so it can be declared as a pgpverify-maven-plugin
        plugin dependency and referenced via a classpath: keysMapLocation,
        the same way org.simplify4u:pgp-keys-map is consumed upstream.
